/.title: XionERP | Cloud ERP with E-Invoicing for the GCC
/.description: XionERP is the all-in-one cloud ERP for growing GCC businesses: accounting, sales, inventory, CRM, manufacturing, projects and e-invoicing for the GCC.
/.h1: Your whole business, in one flow.
/.summary: XionERP is a multi-tenant cloud ERP for growing businesses across the GCC and South Asia, covering accounting, sales, inventory, purchase, CRM, manufacturing, projects, assets and HR on one platform.

/partners.title: Become a XionERP Partner | Reseller and Distributor Program
/partners.description: Apply to become a XionERP reseller or distributor. Bring cloud ERP with e-invoicing for the GCC to businesses in your country.
/partners.summary: Apply to become a XionERP reseller or distributor. Resellers sell and support XionERP for their own customers; distributors cover a whole country and support resellers there. Applying is free, every application is reviewed by our team, and terms are agreed directly with each partner.

/partners/directory.title: Find a XionERP Partner | Distributors and Resellers by Country
/partners/directory.description: Search XionERP distributors and resellers by country. Find the local partner who sells, sets up and supports XionERP cloud ERP near you.
/partners/directory.summary: Search XionERP distributors and resellers by country, company or city. A distributor covers a country; resellers work with local businesses under the distributor of their country.

/academy.title: XionERP Academy | Free Courses and Certificates
/academy.description: Free XionERP courses in two tracks of four stages, for customers and partners. Pass the quiz and get a certificate with a job title for your CV and LinkedIn.
/academy.summary: Free XionERP courses. Customers: Certified User, Operations Specialist, Finance & Accounting Professional, System Administrator. Partners: Partner Essentials, Sales Consultant, Implementation Consultant, Support Specialist. Each has a ten-question quiz and a certificate anyone can verify.

/academy/fundamentals.title: XionERP Certified User | Free Course and Certificate
/academy/fundamentals.description: Learn how XionERP is organised, how to set a company up, and how sales, purchasing, stock and the books fit together. Free, with a certificate.
/academy/fundamentals.summary: Seven short lessons: how XionERP is organised, setting up your company, people and access, products and prices, selling, buying, and stock, bank and the books. A ten-question quiz and a free certificate.

/academy/partner.title: XionERP Partner Essentials | Free Course and Certificate
/academy/partner.description: For resellers and distributors: how the partner programme works, your partner portal, and how to show, set up and support XionERP for a customer. Free, with a certificate.
/academy/partner.summary: Six short lessons for partners: reseller or distributor, your partner portal, finding the right customers, showing XionERP, setting a customer up and supporting your customers. A ten-question quiz and a free certificate.

/academy/operations.title: XionERP Certified Operations Specialist | Free Course and Certificate
/academy/operations.description: Sales, purchasing and inventory in XionERP: sales orders, deliveries, returns, advances, cheques, landed cost, transfers and stock counts. Free, with a certificate.

/academy/finance.title: XionERP Certified Finance & Accounting Professional | Free Course and Certificate
/academy/finance.description: Accounting in XionERP: chart of accounts, journals, bank and card reconciliation, VAT, closing periods and reading the reports. Free, with a certificate.

/academy/admin.title: XionERP Certified System Administrator | Free Course and Certificate
/academy/admin.description: Administering XionERP: users, roles and permissions, company settings, document layouts, numbering, master data, import and entities. Free, with a certificate.
/academy/admin.summary: Six lessons on running XionERP for a company, a ten-question quiz and a free certificate.

/academy/partner-sales.title: XionERP Certified Sales Consultant | Free Course and Certificate
/academy/partner-sales.description: For partners: who XionERP fits, plans and the trial, discovery, demos by business type, objections and closing. Free, with a certificate.

/academy/partner-implementation.title: XionERP Certified Implementation Consultant | Free Course and Certificate
/academy/partner-implementation.description: For partners: the onboarding plan, setup, roles, data import, opening balances at a cut-off date, training and go-live. Free, with a certificate.

/academy/partner-support.title: XionERP Certified Support Specialist | Free Course and Certificate
